% note: The measures, as Pilot~1's ledger defines them. 24\ensuremath{\times}1 is the puzzle as separate pieces and 1\ensuremath{\times}24 as one chain. Whole: the whole-answer accuracy under the original marking rule. Per piece (24\ensuremath{\times}1): the share of pieces right. Final (1\ensuremath{\times}24): the accuracy on the answer line alone (at 24\ensuremath{\times}1 it equals the whole answer). Lines~= key (1\ensuremath{\times}24): the share of step lines equal to the key, over samples whose lines can be placed. Local (1\ensuremath{\times}24): the per-step accuracy with each step judged from the model's own previous line, over samples whose lines can be placed. Format ok (1\ensuremath{\times}24): the share of samples in the required answer format.
% note: Pilot~1's results file gives percentages to one decimal; the cells are copied from it without the percent sign. Calls per cell are the samples named in the Mode column, which keeps the ledger's own wording in quotation marks (its ``tries'' are samples).
% note: Marking rule: Pilot~1's results file was scored with the scorers that were official at the time, under the original marking rule, before Deviation~2. The paper's other tables use Deviation~2's rule; no re-score of these cells under it is stamped.
